entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: I've told you not to call me by name.

entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: Regardless, all that's left is to deal with[n]the remnants.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: The continued deaths of these teenagers[n]would be a bit much, don't you think?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I considered making it appear they had[n]a falling out... but that would only[n]amplify public frenzy...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: It would be best to have each of them[n]meet with an unfortunate accident once[n]the storm blows over.

entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: Is there any possibility they'll want to[n]avenge their leader?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: No chance. They're nothing but cattle[n]anyway... They have no backbone[n]without his guidance.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I will keep my eye on them just in case[n]though.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: They will live their lives cowering in[n]fear of death. An apt punishment for[n]obstructing our work.

entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: Make sure to kill that strange cat[n]once you find it as well.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Understood, though I doubt there is[n]anything to worry about. It's merely[n]a cat, after all.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: More importantly, they should be[n]dealing with the suicide right about now.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Things will become quite busy once the[n]word gets out... I'll need to prepare my[n]comments on the matter.

entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: I must be prepared to deal with it on[n]my end as well.

entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: Beyond that... what of the director[n]of the Special Investigations Unit?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Perhaps he'll be struck by a mysterious[n]illness sometime soon...
